summary: Stardust Power Inc. filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing Amendment No. 2 to a prospectus supplement governing its at-the-market (ATM) equity program under an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with B. Riley Securities, Inc. dated May 8, 2026. The amendment increases the maximum Placement Shares issuable by up to an additional $6,076,872, sold under a Form S-3 (File No. 333-294938) declared effective April 16, 2026, as previously amended September 17, 2026. Thompson Hine LLP's legal opinion is filed as Exhibit 5.1. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment, not a special situation; watch ATM dilution pace and share overhang.
